prefix: Photorealistic costume reference photograph of one real person standing alone, the whole figure from the top of the head to the soles of the feet in frame with a little white space above and below, standing upright and facing the camera, arms relaxed at the sides, hands open and empty, a natural expression. Plain pure white studio background, soft even light, no shadow on the background, no text, no props. Hellenistic Greece, 3rd century BC: clothes of hand-woven wool and linen with a visible weave, each garment one woven rectangle draped, pinned or belted, never tailored; no buttons, no buckles, no zips, no stitched seams, no modern jewellery.
sandals: Flat leather sandals held on by thin thongs knotted round the ankle, with no buckles.

kinds.mercenary: A hired soldier, a lean, weathered man of about thirty with short dark hair and a short dark beard, an ordinary face, bare-headed. A knee-length {colour} wool tunic under a stiff white linen corslet, its shoulder flaps tied down on the chest and a skirt of hanging linen strips at the hips. A short {colour} wool cloak pinned at the right shoulder and hanging down his back. Bronze greaves on the shins. {sandals}
kinds.bandit: A hill bandit, a rough man of about thirty-five with dark hair and a full dark beard, an ordinary face, bare-headed, nothing on his head or neck. A knee-length {colour} wool tunic with a plain leather belt tied, not buckled, and a {colour} wool cloak, a flat rectangle without any hood, pinned at the right shoulder and hanging down his back. Bronze bracers on both forearms. {sandals}
kinds.arche-messenger: A young man, a messenger, short dark hair, bare-headed. A short undyed wool exomis to mid-thigh, one rectangle of cloth pinned at the left shoulder and belted at the waist, leaving his right shoulder, arm and that side of his chest bare. A soft hide sack with a drawstring on a cord across his body.{extra} {sandals}
kinds.accountant: A middle-aged man, a trading house's accountant, short grey-flecked beard. An undyed wool chiton falling to his ankles, and over it a brown wool himation wrapped round his body and thrown over his left shoulder, covering his left arm. {sandals}
kinds.clerk: A young man, a clerk of a trading house, clean-shaven, short dark hair. A knee-length undyed linen chiton pinned at both shoulders and belted with a cord, and a small hinged wooden wax tablet hanging from the cord at his hip. {sandals}
kinds.legislator-man: A white-bearded old man, a legislator. A white linen chiton falling to his ankles, fastened along both upper arms with small bronze pins so it forms loose elbow-length sleeves, a purple cord belt at the waist and a purple woven band along the hem. {sandals}
kinds.legislator-woman: A grey-haired woman, a legislator, her hair gathered at the back of the head. A white linen chiton falling to her ankles, fastened along both upper arms with small bronze pins so it forms loose elbow-length sleeves, a purple cord belt at the waist and a purple woven band along the hem. {sandals}
kinds.priest: An old white-haired man with a white beard, a priest, a wreath of olive leaves on his head. A plain white linen chiton falling to his ankles, fastened along both upper arms with small bronze pins, a red cord belt. {sandals}
kinds.paxos-messenger: A young man, a messenger, curly dark hair, bare-headed. A short blue wool exomis to mid-thigh, one rectangle of cloth pinned at the left shoulder and belted at the waist, leaving his right shoulder, arm and that side of his chest bare. A soft hide sack with a drawstring on a cord at his hip. {sandals}
kinds.merchant: A plump, cheerful middle-aged man, a merchant, a short beard. A knee-length cream wool chiton pinned at both shoulders, with an ochre woven band along the hem, a cord belt, and a small hide purse on a cord at his hip. {sandals}
kinds.goatherd: A wiry, sunburnt goatherd of about forty with unkempt hair and beard. A rough brown wool exomis to mid-thigh, pinned at the left shoulder and tied at the waist with a rope, leaving his right shoulder bare; nothing under it, bare legs. Bare feet.
kinds.scholar: A lean, thoughtful man of about fifty, a scholar, short grey beard. A knee-length grey wool chiton pinned at both shoulders, a cord belt. {sandals}
kinds.librarian: A woman of about forty-five, a librarian, dark hair pinned up. An undyed cream wool chiton falling to her ankles, fastened along both upper arms with small pins, a cord belt. {sandals}
kinds.council: A {who}, a council member of a small Greek city, an ordinary face. A {colour} wool chiton falling to the ankles, and over it a {colour} wool himation wrapped round the body and thrown over the left shoulder, covering the left arm. {sandals}
kinds.runner: A lean young man of about twenty, a runner, short dark hair, bare-headed. A short undyed brown wool tunic to mid-thigh, belted at the waist, bare arms and legs. {sandals}
kinds.priestess: An older woman, a priestess, calm, grey-haired. A white wool peplos falling to her feet, pinned at both shoulders, its folded-over top hanging to the waist, belted, and a white veil over her hair falling to the shoulders. {sandals}
kinds.student-man: A young man of about eighteen, a student, short hair, bare-headed, an ordinary face. A plain {colour} chiton to the knee, pinned at both shoulders and belted at the waist. {sandals}
kinds.student-woman: A young woman of about eighteen, a student, hair tied back, bare-headed, an ordinary face. A plain {colour} chiton falling to her ankles, fastened along both upper arms and belted at the waist. {sandals}

characters.extra: A broad red sash worn across his chest from the right shoulder to the left hip.
